title: Leading Learning #479 — 'Mission drift doesn't happen all at once. It creeps in.'
summary: Jeff Cobb and Celisa Steele's Leading Learning Podcast — the long-running show for the professional learning industry — drops a launch-day episode walking through Incorruptible's four-part governance framework (compliance, purpose, coherence, integrity) and the principle that 'harder is easier.'
blockquote: Mission drift doesn't happen all at once. It creeps in—and, according to our guest, it often happens because organizations are following the so‑called best practices for how to grow and govern.
blockquote_source: Jeff Cobb on the Leading Learning Podcast
attribution_title: Long-running podcast for the professional learning industry, hosted by Jeff Cobb and Celisa Steele
